key_difference: (D) re-decodes %80–%FF sequences as UTF-8 through a new traits struct and the QUtf8Functions decoder, where (B) treats any remaining byte >= 0x80 as already-invalid UTF-8 and fails; (D) also lacks (B)'s Windows precheck for literal (stored-decoded) backslashes in the input, so a path containing '\' is not rejected on Windows.
